title: World Bloom — With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail! — Episode8 We're Capturing It?!

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!
meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime's training continues as they each pursue their dreams. When they're called over to SEKAI by Rin and the others one day, they find an expansive new land awaiting them!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link_wonder_op4
A few hours later
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmmmmm... Still no phoenix...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
Yes...
But I still believe this is where it will most likely appear.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: That phoenix seems to prefer quiet places such as this hill. No plushies will disturb it since none live here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, we'll just have to keep waiting.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: We have to find it so that we can ask it to let me sit on top of its back...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He seems much more confident compared to a little while ago. What Emu said must've lit a fire underneath him.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: I really admire it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He admires it...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The details of our dreams may differ, but what Rion and I have in common is looking up and aiming high...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So, I'd like to do everything I can to help make his dream come true.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You two have been standing for quite a while now. Aren't you tired? Why don't I watch instead? You can take a break and—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoooaaaa!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look, everyone! Over there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Isn't that...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I-I-I-It's...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's here! The phoenix actually came!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: R-R-R-R-R-R-R-R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Incoming from the northwest.
It is the same bird we saw from the ship.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right... That is it.
I can't believe it's actually here...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your prediction was spot on, Rion.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! I'm so happy for our phoenix expert!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
I-I'm no expert...
But I am glad that my research ended up helping!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now we need to try talking to it.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: What? But it's so high up. How are we going to...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, no worries there. As it so happens, Tsukasa can...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heeeeeey, Phooooeeenix!!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ...project his voice very far.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: W-Wow...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: 110 decibels. On the order of a car honking its horn.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-How is it possible for anyone to be this loud?! I thought I was gonna go deaf there...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But I think he got its attention!
Look, it's coming towards us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! It's so gusty!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Its enormous wings must allow it to move an inordinate amount of air...

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: So it was you who made that obnoxious sound just now...

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: Humans, plushie, what business do you have with me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm very sorry, Phoenix, but we have a big favor to ask of you!

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: A favor?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me...!
But... Would it be possible for me to sit on your back as you fly?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is Rion! He really admires you and has been dreaming of flying through the skies on your back...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, please...!
Will you let him fly with you?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I beg you as well!

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: No.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: Under what obligation am I to listen to your pleas?

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
Now, begone from this place.
Even from the sky, you looked like pathetic ants.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, you are under no obligation to listen to our pleas...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But Rion's been dreaming of this moment for a very long time! So, once again, I beg you!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: P-Please...!

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: Fine. I may be willing to oblige if you are willing to beg in such a manner.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...? R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: Yes. However, I have one condition.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: One condition? What would that be...?

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: First, you must capture me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Capture you?!

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: If you can catch me while I fly through the air, then I shall do as you say.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Catch it... All the way up there...
How are we supposed to...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, we can do this...
Regardless of how impossible this challenge may sound, we'll figure out a way.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we have your word?

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: Yes, but I doubt you will succeed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fine, you're on!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rion, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Y-Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, we're going to catch that phoenix one way or another! Are you all ready to do that?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
You have until the sun sets into the sea.
I promise to remain here until it does. So, good luck.

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: We shall see how you fare.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to catch that phoenix and help make Rion's dream a reality...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, let's do everything we can for that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Even though we're likely going to face countless obstacles along the way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Starting with... How in the world are we going to catch something of that size?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, what if we used one of those giant nets?! Like the one we used to catch Lion Dance Robot!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, excellent idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which leads into our next question... Verticality. How do we reach the heights it can...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmmm... Oh, I know!
Can you fly, Robo-Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? You're kidding, right...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Unfortunately, no.
I do not possess the ability to fly so high.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I was just thinking how “flying” may be the way to go...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Can you make it so Robo-Nene can fly?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. No, I won't immediately be able to get Robo-Nene to fly as high as that phoenix...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But flight could be achieved by jumping high.
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui! We got that thing you asked for!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much.
I'm also just about finished working on Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Her eyes are glowing!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Checking systems... No issues detected.
Checking sensors and monitors. All normal.
My new “super jump” function is fully operational.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that so? I don't know what that actually involves, but it sounds powerful...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, we'll be able to reach that phoenix now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I've upgraded Robo-Nene's legs in a way that will now allow her to jump significantly higher than before.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Significantly higher? So, what about the landing...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I also have that covered.
The backpack I've attached to her will help break her fall by emitting a burst of air prior to impact.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll also have a landing pad ready just in case.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, all of that required quite a bit of power, so the battery will only be able to handle around three attempts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's also another problem...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Another problem?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: While super-jumping, Robo-Nene won't be able to do anything else. That means someone else will need to cast the net over the phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: The net...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
Then, I'll do it!
You've already helped me this much, so I should be responsible for the final step of making my dream come true...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rion...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, in that case, I'll go with you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That phoenix frankly dwarfs you, so you're going to need some help casting this net.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
A-Are you sure?
This seems incredibly dangerous as it is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, after seeing your enthusiasm.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As someone who is also chasing after a seemingly impossible dream... I feel compelled to help you make yours come true.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much...!
I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, then...
We'll be counting on you both, Tsukasa, Rion.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, we'll get the landing pad ready.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We promise to catch you guys both no matter what, Tsukasa, Rion!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Now, let's go...!
